title: PVRP-MP-IF benchmark instances adapted from Taverna and Tilk

creators.name: Dávid, Balázs
creators.affiliation: InnoRenew CoE, UP IAM and UP FAMNIT, University of Primorska

description: Benchmark instances for the periodic vehicle routing problem with preferred pickup days, multiple service periods and intermediate facilities (PVRP-MP-IF), adapted from the PVRP-IF waste-collection instances of Taverna and Tilk (2026), together with the instance subsets used in the parameter tuning and in the algorithmic component analysis of the accompanying paper.
